meta.name: process:reconciliation
meta.description: 231 (plan stage C, C2d; DECISIONS 231): the reconciliation of bank statements and invoices as a process pack (until C2d its own kind of package). A case belongs to an own party and a period and reconciles the party's accounts and cards (or those a person chooses): the invoices and the statements other packages processed are read by its scope, code proposes which statement line paid which invoice, a person decides and approves the reconciliation statement (its Excel file from the chosen template). The invoices and the statements are processed in their own packages, as before. Every step names a general capability; the pack holds no code.

changelog.note: 231 (C2d): the first version: the pairing step (pairing@1, the invoices against the statement lines) and its tabs: Invoices, Bank statements, Pairing, Reconciliation statement, History; started by hand for a party and a period, its accounts by default the party's.
